text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - Sev2 - increased OOM and container restarts on serving-pool-3 (region: us-west-2). Alerting pages.

kim.p: seeing repeated small memory creep on paged-attn allocator. KV resident pages slowly rising on gpunode-14, then cudaIllegalAddress -> container restart. Logs attached in cluster.

sam: confirmed. stack: paged-attn allocator -> kv-cache growth -> refcount churn -> fragmentation. Node flaps when refill hits 95% mem.

maya: customer impact: a subset of requests to /v1/generate return 502 or hang 30-60s. Top hit: internal payment-checker and a few high-qps PLG keys.

ravi: repro locally with long-prefix workloads + streaming enabled. patchy on A100 and T4. More common when batching window > 40.

kim.p: snippets from gpunode-14:```
E cuda: cudaErrorIllegalAddress at 0x7f3b...
W allocator: page_frag: free_count=12 resident=192MB -> 480MB over 3h
I kvcache: evict_scan skipping stale slots: 0 -> growth
```

sam: quick mitigation options: 1) set allocator.eviction_threshold=0.6 on serving-pool-3 2) disable continuous batching for affected routes 3) trigger compact on node -> /admin/allocator/compact 4) cordon+drain hot node if compaction fails

maya: ops: we already see a node bounce, 2 restarts in last 10m. customers seeing retries. Can we put a temporary rate limit on the model route?

ops-bot: Rate limit applied: model=open-llama-7b-quant, qps cap=50 for 1h (applied).

ravi: doing compact and lowering eviction threshold now. posting commands:```
# compact
curl -X POST http://gpunode-14.internal:6060/admin/allocator/compact
# lower threshold
curl -X POST http://console.internal/api/v1/pools/serving-pool-3/config -d '{"allocator.eviction_threshold":0.6}'
```

taylor: FYI if compact succeeds, monitor reclaimed pages and refcount delta. If not, we should restart the container with env DISABLE_PAGING=true to temporarily remove paged-attn path.

kim.p: compact returned: "reclaimed=120MB, fragmentation=0.18" - some relief but resident still trending up.

sam: check kernel OOM events — none on host; it's container-level GPU OOMs. That matches cudaErrorIllegalAddress followed by process crash.

ravi: after compaction, did a graceful restart of process on gpunode-14. Post-restart telemetry: resident dropped to baseline, but two other nodes show slow upticks (gpunode-17, gpunode-19).

maya: action for customer ops: notify top 3 affected customers about degraded latencies and retries; we have soft fallback currently (model-fallback -> smaller model).

kim.p: applied per-route fallback policy to redirect 10% -> open-llama-3b-quant for the affected orgs.

sam: long-term mitigation ideas noted in thread: - fix refcount bug in paged-attn slot reclamation - add aggressive periodic compaction job - improve eviction heuristics to target fragmentation hotspots - add canary that rejects very long prefixes when paging enabled

maya: current status: traffic cap in place, compaction + restarts done, fallbacks configured. Customer ops notified. Degraded but stable.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE - Sev2 -> active, assigned to oncall.

ravi: I'm taking ownership for the handoff. I'll run an overnight watch with a script to poll resident growth and auto-trigger compact at delta>50MB/hr. Leaving checklist: [1] watch gpunode-14,17,19; [2] keep qps cap; [3] if any node has >2 restarts in 30m -> cordon and rotate; [4] file bug for paged-attn refcount.

taylor: ping if you need a manual kernel-evict or to roll pool. I'll be around for next 2h to help.

kim.p: thanks. leaving additional logs in incident board and linking evals that reproduce memory growth.

ravi: handoff note to next oncall: runbook stored at /runbooks/paged-attn-oom.md, grep for "ghosthole" scenario. Next update in 30m or on any regression.

ops-bot: Handoff: incident assigned -> ravi. Pager rotations updated. :white_check_mark:
